    model = config.get("model", "nova-2")

    query_string = "&".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in query_params.items())
    uri = "wss://api.deepgram.com/v1/listen"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Token {api_key}"}

    async def _streamer():
        async with websockets.connect(uri, extra_headers=headers, query_string=query_string) as ws:
            try:
                async for chunk in payload:
                    await ws.send(chunk)
                await ws.send(b"")
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                async for message in ws:
                    data = json.loads(message)
                    if data.get("type") == "Error":
                        yield {"error": data.get("message", "Unknown error")}
                        return
                    if "channel" in data and data["channel"].get("alternatives"):
                        alternative = data["channel"]["alternatives"][0]
                        text = alternative.get("transcript", "").strip()
                        if text:
                            yield {
                                "text": text,
                                "is_final": data.get("is_final", False),
